entries.name: Navigation

Works in the Sandbox, the Page Builder canvas, and any composed/hand-written template that loads navigation.js.

entries.name: Blog post
entries.notes: Converted to composed template on 2026-05-25 (CLAUDE.md §4f) — composes navigation + blog-article + footer via iframes so module edits propagate automatically. Template-level states (default / long-form / with-cover) pass through to the blog-article module via URL ?state=. Article slots (title, author, body, cover, etc.) live on the blog-article module's Sandbox. Removed 2026-06-05 during library cleanup — keeping only navigation + footer to start the portfolio fresh. Source dir deleted (composed blog-article, now also removed).

entries.name: test-page
entries.notes: First page built via the Page Builder. Declarative composition (ADR 0004): preview.html assembles navigation + homepage-hero + footer from composition.json at runtime, so module updates propagate automatically. Hero image ships as %LOCAL_IMAGE% — provide a real URL or asset path before publishing. Removed 2026-06-05 during library cleanup — keeping only navigation + footer to start the portfolio fresh. Source dir deleted (composed homepage-hero, now also removed).

entries.name: Button — Ghost
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Borderless, transparent-on-default button — used for tertiary actions and overflow menus.

entries.name: Button — Destructive
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Uses --error for the fill — for irreversible destructive actions only.

entries.name: Icon Button
entries.notes: Starter primitive. 36×36 square holding a single Phosphor glyph. Default is ghost; data-variant="primary" fills with --accent.

entries.name: Toggle Button
entries.notes: Starter primitive. toggle-button.js flips aria-pressed on click; ON uses --accent-subtle bg + --accent border. Dispatches loom:toggle (detail.pressed:boolean).

entries.name: Segmented Control
entries.notes: Starter primitive. segmented-control.js switches aria-selected on click; dispatches loom:change (detail.index, detail.value). 3–4 segments max.

entries.name: Dropdown Menu
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Open-state panel with menuitem buttons, dividers, keyboard shortcuts, and a destructive-toned item. dropdown-menu.js provides the declarative anchor pattern: data-loom-dropdown-trigger="<id>" on the trigger element. Dispatches loom:menu-select (detail.label, detail.tone) and closes on item click / outside click / Escape.

entries.name: Text Input
entries.notes: Starter primitive. 40px height, 10px corner, focus ring uses --accent.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.notes: Starter primitive. min-height 96px, resize vertical, same border/focus treatment as input-text.

entries.name: Select
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Native <select> with custom chevron via Phosphor — keeps screen reader semantics.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.notes: Starter primitive. checkbox.js toggles on click + Space/Enter; aria-checked synced. Pure-CSS checkmark + dash (no Unicode glyphs). entries.name: Radio Group
entries.notes: Starter primitive. radio-group.js selects on click + Space/Enter + ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right between options. 5px accent border ring (no inner dot — cleaner at small sizes). Dispatches loom:change (detail.index, detail.value).

entries.name: Switch
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Track flips to --accent on data-on="Starter primitive. checkbox.js toggles on click + Space/Enter; aria-checked synced. Pure-CSS checkmark + dash (no Unicode glyphs). Dispatches loom:change (detail.checked:boolean)."; thumb slides via transition.

entries.name: Slider
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Pointer + keyboard drag via slider.js (arrows = ±1, shift+arrow = ±10, Home/End = boundaries).

entries.name: Date Picker
entries.notes: Starter primitive. date-picker.js handles month navigation (prev/next carets) and single-date selection. Range selection is the next polish pass.

entries.name: Combobox
entries.notes: Starter primitive. combobox.js handles live filter, <mark> highlighting, and ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape keyboard nav. Listen for the loom:combobox-select event to react to picks.

slots.label: Media

slots.default: Identity, site, and motion package shipping May 24.

entries.notes: Starter primitive. 12px radius, 1px border, no shadow. Selected state uses --accent border + inset shadow.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Initials in mono. data-size={sm|lg} and data-variant="accent" for variants.

entries.name: Badge
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Pill-shaped status indicator. Locked label-to-variant convention — Active is always success, Away is always warning, Suspended is always error.

entries.name: Tag
entries.notes: Starter primitive. 10px radius (matches button), mono text. Use --tone="accent" for the featured variant.

entries.name: Data Table
entries.notes: Starter primitive. data-table.js handles row selection (click) and column sort (click header — cycles asc → desc → none). Dispatches loom:row-select (detail.row, detail.selected, detail.cells) and loom:sort-change (detail.column, detail.direction). Inline status pills follow the locked label-to-variant rule from Badge.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Shimmer animation between --surface2 and --border-visible. Use sparingly — prefer empty-state over skeleton when the page has copy to share.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.notes: Starter primitive. tabs.js switches aria-selected on click; ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End move focus. Underline-style tabs; active uses --accent bottom border. Dispatches loom:tab-change (detail.index, detail.label).

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Mono, lowercase, slash separators. Current item marked via aria-current="page".

entries.name: Pagination
entries.notes: Starter primitive. pagination.js switches aria-current on click; prev/next step ±1 within the numbered set. Current page uses --accent fill. Dispatches loom:page-change (detail.page:int).

entries.name: Nav Menu
entries.notes: Starter primitive. nav-menu.js switches aria-current on click (prevents default for # hrefs). Active item uses --surface2 — not accent fill, since accent is reserved for CTAs. Dispatches loom:nav-change (detail.label, detail.href).

entries.name: Link
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Inline accent link. Hover adds underline.

entries.name: Alert
entries.notes: Starter primitive. alert.js dismisses on close-button click with fade-out. Cancel via preventDefault on loom:alert-dismiss to keep the alert visible. Four severity levels via data-tone. Body copy stays specific — name the file, the user, the timestamp.

entries.name: Toast
entries.notes: Starter primitive. toast.js wires the action button + optional data-timeout auto-dismiss. Dynamic API: LoomToast.show({ text, action, timeout }) / LoomToast.hide(el). Inverted (--text1 bg, --background fg). Action click dispatches loom:toast-action.

entries.name: Progress
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Bar variant only — ring/circle is a future polish pass. Set --variant="indeterminate" for the marching style.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Accent stroke on a --surface2 ring. Three sizes via data-size.

entries.notes: Starter primitive. modal.js provides LoomModal.open(panel) / LoomModal.close(panel) with backdrop, focus trap, Escape-to-close, and backdrop-click-to-close. Declarative bindings: data-loom-modal-open="<id>" on the trigger, data-loom-modal-close inside the panel. Composes with button-primary + button-ghost.

slots.label: Body

entries.notes: Starter primitive. popover.js anchors the panel to a trigger element via data-loom-popover-trigger="<id>". Click outside or press Escape to dismiss. Side override via data-loom-popover-side on the trigger.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Inverted color (--text1 bg). 4-direction arrow via data-side. tooltip.js powers the dynamic hover behavior: add data-loom-tooltip="text" + optional data-loom-tooltip-side="top|bottom|left|right" to any element. The static [data-loom="tooltip"] markup is the visual demo and isn't touched by the script.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.notes: Starter primitive. Native <details>/<summary>. Caret rotates 90° on open.

entries.notes: Portfolio homepage — incremental build to the Figma 'June 2026' wireframe (BLOCK A, file fqfwIkPzFHLw4FcEePUeiW, nodes 2021:3 resting / 2021:78 open; refs in .figma-ref/, gitignored). Piece 1 = resting state: name top-left, bio bottom-left, tabbed 'My Projects' FOLDER on the right (manila-tab metaphor, line-work on cream). Intentionally a HAND-WRITTEN template (not the composed/iframed pattern) because the planned takeover animation must move name + folder within one DOM. Vanilla; no stack triggered. Next: folder polish/tab-slant + open state (folder grows, name→nav-logo, P1–P4 tabs spread, title + body + 2×2 image grid), then the takeover animation (new motion category, drift-C).
